mapper.select: SELECT b.book_id AS bookId, b.title AS bookTitle, b.author, b.category AS genre, COUNT(*) AS borrowCount FROM borrow_record br JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title, b.author, b.category ORDER BY borrowCount DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT b.author, COUNT(*) AS borrowCount FROM borrow_record br JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.author ORDER BY borrowCount DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT b.category AS genre, COUNT(*) AS borrowCount FROM borrow_record br JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.category ORDER BY borrowCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT b.book_id AS bookId, b.title AS bookTitle, b.author, b.category AS genre, COUNT(*) AS borrowCount FROM borrow_record br JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.book_id WHERE b.author = #{author} GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title, b.author, b.category ORDER BY borrowCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'RETURNED' AND return_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date IS NOT NULL AND return_date <= due_date
